moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Out Now
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart Top 40 has just been updated today, revealing the biggest tracks across the country.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reveal
angles.copy: What's hitting number one this week? The brand new Official UK Singles Chart Top 40 is out now, get ready for the freshest hits!

angles.name: Weekend Playlist Prep
angles.copy: Your weekend playlist just got an upgrade! The new UK Singles Chart is here – what new bangers are you adding?

moments.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
moments.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21st, 2026.

angles.name: Still a Rock Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

angles.name: Iconic Frontman
angles.copy: 54 years young for the legendary Liam Gallagher today. From 'Definitely Maybe' to 'C'mon You Know', he's an undeniable icon.

moments.title: Andrea Bocelli Turns 68
moments.blurb: The world-renowned Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli celebrates his 68th birthday on September 22nd, 2026.

angles.name: Voice of an Angel
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Andrea Bocelli! His voice truly transcends genres and touches the soul.

angles.name: Timeless Tenor
angles.copy: Celebrating the magnificent Andrea Bocelli on his 68th birthday. From operatic masterpieces to unforgettable duets, what's your favourite from the maestro?

moments.title: Joan Jett Turns 68
moments.blurb: Rock 'n' roll legend Joan Jett, known for 'I Love Rock 'n Roll' and The Runaways, celebrates her 68th birthday on September 22nd, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Rock
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the ultimate Queen of Rock 'n' Roll, Joan Jett! Still a 'Bad Reputation' and we love it.

angles.name: Iconic Anthem
angles.copy: It's Joan Jett's 68th birthday! What better way to celebrate than blasting 'I Love Rock 'n Roll' all day?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Arrives
moments.blurb: The astronomical Autumn Equinox officially marks the start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere on Wednesday, September 23rd, 2026, at 01:05 BST.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Out with summer, in with autumn! The Autumn Equinox officially arrives today at 01:05 BST. Time for cosy nights and crunchy leaves!

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: Happy Autumn Equinox! From today, the nights draw in as we officially welcome astronomical autumn. What's your favourite thing about this season?

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen Turns 77
moments.blurb: American rock legend 'The Boss' Bruce Springsteen celebrates his 77th birthday on September 23rd, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Bruce Springsteen! Still 'Born to Run' and captivating audiences worldwide.

angles.name: Living Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating 77 years of 'The Boss'! Bruce Springsteen's anthems have defined generations. What's your top Springsteen track?

moments.title: Julio Iglesias Turns 83
moments.blurb: The iconic Spanish singer Julio Iglesias, one of the best-selling artists of all time, celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 23rd, 2026.

angles.name: Romantic Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Julio Iglesias! His romantic voice has charmed millions across the globe.

angles.name: Timeless Ballads
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring career of Julio Iglesias on his 83rd birthday. What's your favourite timeless ballad from the Spanish superstar?

moments.title: Will Smith Turns 58
moments.blurb: Actor, rapper, and global superstar Will Smith celebrates his 58th birthday on September 25th, 2026.

angles.name: Fresh Prince Forever
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the multi-talented Will Smith! From the Fresh Prince to Hollywood blockbusters, he's done it all.

angles.name: Music & Movies Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Will Smith's 58th today! Whether it's a rap anthem or a movie soundtrack, his impact is undeniable. What's your favourite Will Smith moment?

moments.title: Avril Lavigne Turns 42
moments.blurb: Pop-punk princess and 'Sk8er Boi' singer Avril Lavigne celebrates her 42nd birthday on September 27th, 2026.

angles.name: Sk8er Girl Turns 42
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the one and only Avril Lavigne! Still rocking our worlds since 'Complicated'.

angles.name: Pop Punk Queen
angles.copy: The pop-punk queen, Avril Lavigne, turns 42 today! Which of her iconic tracks is still on your playlist?

moments.title: Lil Wayne Turns 44
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper and hip-hop icon Lil Wayne celebrates his 44th birthday on September 27th, 2026.

angles.name: Legendary Rapper
angles.copy: Happy 44th Birthday to the legendary Lil Wayne! From Cash Money to Young Money, he's left an indelible mark on hip-hop.

angles.name: Weezy F Baby
angles.copy: It's Weezy F Baby's 44th birthday! What's your all-time favourite Lil Wayne track or feature?
